recognize_zh: S-100 免疫染色中，左側一大片細胞核卵圓、帶核溝、胞質豐富的蘭格漢斯細胞同時呈細胞核與胞質陽性，與右側陰性的小淋巴球區域分界清楚，支持 LCH（但 S-100 不具專一性，需搭配 CD1a/langerin）。
features: Large sheet of lesional cells on the left with moderate-to-strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S-100 staining
Lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval, folded/grooved nuclei visible through the stain
Negative small lymphocytes forming the background on the right
Scattered individual S-100 positive cells at the edge of the infiltrate
Occasional small clear spaces within the infiltrate
describe_en: S-100 immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows a sheet of large lesional cells with abundant cytoplasm and oval, grooved nuclei displaying moderate to strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining, sharply demarcated from S-100-negative small lymphocytes. Scattered single positive cells extend into the adjacent lymphoid tissue. S-100 positivity supports a dendritic/Langerhans cell phenotype and, together with CD1a and langerin, is consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are also strongly S-100 positive, but they are much larger with emperipolesis and are CD1a/langerin negative.
IDC sarcoma is S-100 positive but CD1a and langerin negative, with spindle-to-ovoid cells in a paracortical distribution.
Melanoma is S-100 positive but also SOX10, Melan-A and HMB-45 positive, and CD1a/langerin negative.
